prompt:
Workflow step: Use the fixed robot arm to move the test tube from capping device to test tube rack 2.
Inspection timing: after this step
Inspection location: test tube rack 2
What the inspection checks: Check whether there is a capped test tube containing colored liquid on test tube rack 2.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: Low-angle view of a bench setup. Centre-left: a black plastic rack or holder with slotted openings, one of which holds an upright clear tube capped with an orange screw cap; the tube contains a red/pink liquid filling the visible upper portion. Adjacent rack slots appear empty, with a dark circular insert visible beside the tube. Behind the rack, a white and magenta panel carries a black-and-white square fiducial/QR-style marker, with partial text "R..." to its right. At right, a vertical aluminium extrusion frame with bolt heads runs up the image; a black cable hangs down from an object at the top edge. Background is a plain pale wall and ceiling. White plastic pieces sit at bottom centre.
observations: The rack holds an upright clear tube fitted with an orange screw cap and containing red/pink liquid, matching the expected capped, colored-liquid tube on rack 2.
